doesNotKnow: Reduce equal partition to a half-total reachability DP and reject odd totals before searching.

misconception: Two equal groups require searching two independent subset choices.
objective: Reduce equal partition to a half-total reachability DP and reject odd totals before searching.

claims.text: Equal groups must each sum to half the total. The witness reduces partition to reachability; an odd total rules out an integer half before any subset transitions.
